values.base: byot uses the camera only to scan the pairing code for your OpenCode server.
values.en: byot uses the camera only to scan the pairing code for your OpenCode server.
values.zh-Hans: byot 仅使用相机扫描 OpenCode 服务器的配对码。

values.base: byot finds OpenCode servers on your network and connects to the ones you add by local address.
values.en: byot finds OpenCode servers on your network and connects to the ones you add by local address.
values.zh-Hans: byot 会查找你网络中的 OpenCode 服务器，并连接你通过本地地址添加的服务器。

values.base: byot listens only while you dictate a message, and only after you tap the microphone.
values.en: byot listens only while you dictate a message, and only after you tap the microphone.
values.zh-Hans: byot 仅在你轻点麦克风并听写消息时收听。

values.base: byot turns what you dictate into message text. Speech is transcribed on this device when your language supports it; otherwise Apple transcribes it.
values.en: byot turns what you dictate into message text. Speech is transcribed on this device when your language supports it; otherwise Apple transcribes it.
values.zh-Hans: byot 会将你的听写内容转换为消息文本。如果你的语言支持，语音会在本设备上转写；否则由 Apple 转写。
